newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar sees Q2 GDP rise above 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar sees Q2 GDP rise above 3.0 pct.

text.p: Spain's Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Sunday that the gross domestic product (GDP) would exceed 3.0 percent in the second quarter after nearly reaching that level in the first three months of 1997.

"We had almost three percent GDP in the first three months," Aznar told a news conference after a meeting with Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewic in Madrid. "We will see it not only reach, but exceed that level in the second quarter."
Aznar said Spain was living in an "excellent" economic period and all the indicators pointed to more than three percent growth in the months April through June.
The government's budget had forecast 1997 GDP would grow by three percent, a level needed to help reach criteria for joining Europe's economic and monetary union.
